title: SCA i zavisnosti
summary: SCA sa osv-scannerom i Trivyjem, prioritizacija po CVSS, EPSS i KEV, pinovanje i automatska ažuriranja (Renovate, Dependabot), odbrana od dependency confusion i zlonamjernih paketa te provjera licenci.
summary_en: SCA with osv-scanner and Trivy, prioritizing by CVSS, EPSS and KEV, pinning and automated updates (Renovate, Dependabot), defending against dependency confusion and malicious packages, and license checks.
